about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: You were matched because you both share interests like live music and gigs, and you enjoy similar weekends at the cinema. They are also the laid-back kind of mentor you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet with your mentor every two weeks.

checklist.reply: I can go through your checklist with you here, one task at a time. {{checklist}}

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you are studying BA English Literature, [[English]] is a great fit for meeting others on your course.

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: The mentoring coordinator is still finding you a mentor by hand, so you haven't been matched with one just yet.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't got a mentor yet, but I can find you one here. {{mentor}}

change mentor.ask: I don’t think my mentor is right for me. Can I change?
change mentor.reply: You can ask the mentoring coordinator for someone else here, and only they will see why. {{change-mentor}}
